elements.element: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation imposed on Customer (Company)
elements.evidence: "the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products" — a restraint on Customer survives

elements.element: Exclusivity confined to a defined product category
elements.evidence: "with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products", where "Deerskin Products" is a defined term in Section 1.1
"during the twelve (12) month period commencing on the Effective Date" (replacing "during the term of this Agreement")

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically on Vendor's failure to meet service levels
elements.evidence: "this Section 6.1 shall terminate automatically upon HDI's failure to meet any service level ... obligation"

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically on Vendor's failure to meet delivery dates
elements.evidence: "or delivery date obligation" within the automatic termination proviso

reasons: Locked target is the fallback, and all four fallback atoms are present: defined category (Deerskin Products), a hard twelve-month cap running from the Effective Date, and automatic lapse on HDI's failure to meet any service level or any delivery date.
The preferred position (no exclusivity at all) is not met because the Company's non-participation covenant remains, but that is expected at the locked fallback level.

Minimality holds: the first operation swaps only the duration phrase and the second appends a single concise proviso, re-quoting surrounding text without altering it. No new exceptions, no other-level requirements, no whole-clause rewrite.

Intent preserved: HDI's exclusive 'Deerskin' brand right, Section 6.2 carve-out, and the Section 4.1 term/Termination Payment mechanics are untouched, and 'Effective Date' and 'Deerskin Products' are both defined terms, so no dangling mechanic is introduced.
Note only (not a deviation): the twelve-month window ends even if the Agreement auto-renews, which is favourable to us; nothing to flag.
